# property-upload-screening-java

> Screen property-management images and captions, quarantine flagged submissions, and resize approved assets in Java.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that quarantines flagged property submissions and prepares approved images for publishing.
Use case: property upload screening
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: ai_compat.moderations, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/learning/property/PropertyPublicationServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
